responsibility: Defines the DFA scheduling model for the XiangShan Nanhu microarchitecture. It describes the processor’s issue resources and reservations for jump/branch, integer ALU, multiply/divide, floating-point add/mul/misc/div/sqrt, and load/store units, including a broad placeholder reservation for otherwise unmapped RISC-V and RVV instruction types, so the scheduler can tune instruction ordering specifically for `-mtune=xiangshan`.
